milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting red_dye from poppies results in red_dye appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 2 poppies and no red_dye, so having at least 1 red_dye confirms the crafting was performed.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because decorating the home means placing decorative blocks inside the house interior. The player can craft red_wool (red_dye + white_wool) or red_carpet (red_dye + white_carpet) and place them inside. We check for red_wool blocks placed within a generous box covering the house interior (spawn-relative coords from [-4,0,2] to [5,5,11], which is the house footprint ±1 in each direction). At least 1 red_wool block must be placed to confirm decoration. We also check for red_carpet as an alternative decoration.
